Opens portals anywhere in existence. Housed in the Tesseract, which Odin hid on Earth and HYDRA later used to power its weapons. First seen in Thor (2011).
Controls minds and consciousness. Hidden in Loki's scepter in The Avengers (2012), it later gave life to Vision and sat in his forehead.
Bends matter and reality to the user's will. First seen as the liquid Aether in Thor: The Dark World (2013).
Immense destructive energy, too much for most mortals to hold. Sealed in the Orb, which Star-Lord stole from Morag in Guardians of the Galaxy (2014).
Rewinds, fast-forwards and loops time. Worn by Doctor Strange, who used it to trap Dormammu in a time loop in Doctor Strange (2016).
Governs life and the soul itself. Guarded on Vormir by Red Skull, it can only be claimed by sacrificing a loved one. First seen in Avengers: Infinity War (2018).
